# severity: critical (always aborts) | suspicious (aborts unless allowlisted
# for the Vetted Commit) | info (logged). A trailing backslash continues a
# record on the next line, dropping exactly one leading TAB (so a line
# opening with two TABs starts the next field).
#   code     every tracked text file but .SRCINFO, minus comments and
#   install  *.install scriptlets (run as root by pacman)
#   builtin  engine-coded check; ERE is `-`, severity/description live here
# unless: a line matching it is skipped (e.g. echo'd instructions).
